content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PD alert fired for service=infra-inference-gateway (eu-west1). 5xx rate jumped from ~4% to ~48% in 2m. Alert: https://pd.example.com/alerts/P12345 :rotating_light:

alice.ops: I’m on it — acknowledging PD. Investigating ingress and recent deploys.

ben.runtime: saw the same in our traces. A canary rollout for gateway-proxy went out ~3m ago (image: rwdw/gw-proxy:2026-03-17-8c9f). Could be a proxy regression.

carla.cs: Customer impact: a few EU customers reporting failed chat completions. CS is triaging support tickets, flagging high-usage tenants.

alice.ops: quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep gateway` shows many gateway pods crashlooping with 502s in logs. Posting a snippet:

```
2026-03-17T12:04:02Z gateway-proxy[1]: upstream read timeout, connection reset by peer
2026-03-17T12:04:03Z gateway-proxy[1]: returning 502 to client
```

ben.runtime: that looks like upstream auth proxy (oauth-proxy) rejecting or slow. I’ll roll the canary back to previous image for eu cluster. Rolling now.

alice.ops: meanwhile scaling replicas up and enabling extra capacity on the fallback route. Running:

```bash
kubectl scale deployment/gateway-proxy -n inference --replicas=8
kubectl patch svc gateway-route -n inference -p '{"spec":{"externalTrafficPolicy":"Cluster"}}'
```

ops-bot: autoscaler triggered +3 instances for node-pool-eu-west1 (reason: cpu & pod pending).

pagerbot: Escalation rule: if incident remains unacknowledged by SRE lead in 5m, paging escalation to +sre-lead. (timer started)

carla.cs: CS says failed rate concentrated on requests with Authorization header present — possible token introspect latency. Noting affected tenants: tenant-42, tenant-alpha.

ben.runtime: roll back completed to rwdw/gw-proxy:2026-03-10-1a2b. New pods coming up; watching health checks.

alice.ops: after rollback, 5xx rate trending down from 48% -> 15% in last 90s. Traces show reduced latency to token introspect service.

ben.runtime: adding temporary routing rule to prefer auth-proxy replica pool with freshest cache. Also enabling cache warmup for introspect tokens.

carla.cs: Notifying affected customers: short ETA ~10m for stabilization. Creating status page update draft.

alice.ops: Confirming mitigation: rollback + scaling + routing change. Continuing to monitor. If rates hold <5% for 10m, we can close.

incident-bot: Metric snapshot: 5xx spike peak 52% at 12:05 UTC, current 4xx+5xx = 6% (steady).

ben.runtime: will follow up with postmortem candidate: possible regression in upstream retry/backoff in the new proxy image. Saving logs and tracing spans: `trace: https://jaeger.example.local/trace/xyz`

carla.cs: support notes sent. PR for rollback flagged for postmortem analysis.

alice.ops: thanks team. Filing incident ticket INC-2026-03-17-48 for tracking. If anything flares, ping here. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: Incident unack escalator canceled (SRE lead acknowledged within window).

ops-bot: Monitoring flags recovered; closing alert in 2m unless new anomalies.

alice.ops: closing thread — incident mitigated, customers notified. Follow-up: assign to ben for RCA and backfill test coverage for token introspect timeouts. :white_check_mark:
